title: Symbolic Computation in R
code: library(symcompR) x <- Symbol("x"); y <- Symbol("y") n <- Symbol("n", integer = TRUE) f <- Function("f")  expand((x + y)^3) #> x^3 + 3*x^2*y + 3*x*y^2 + y^3  sym_factor(x^4 - 1) #> (x - 1)*(x + 1)*(x^2 + 1)  diff(sin(x) * exp(x), x) #> exp(x)*sin(x) + exp(x)*cos(x)  sym_integrate(exp(-x^2), list(x, -Inf, Inf)) #> sqrt(pi)  limit(sin(x) / x, x, 0) #> 1  series(tan(x), x, 0, 8) #> x + x^3/3 + 2*x^5/15 + 17*x^7/315 + O(x^8)  solveset(sin(x) - Rational(1, 2), x, Reals) #> Union(ImageSet(Lambda(_n, 2*_n*pi + pi/6), Integers), ImageSet(Lambda(_n, 2*_n*pi + 5*pi/6), Integers))  dsolve(Eq(diff(f(x), x, 2) + f(x), 0), f(x)) #> Eq(f(x), C1*sin(x) + C2*cos(x))  summation(1/n^2, list(n, 1, Inf)) #> pi^2/6  M <- Matrix(list(list(1, 2), list(3, 4))) inverse(M) #> Matrix(2, 2) #> [-2 , 1   ] #> [3/2, -1/2]  latex(Integral(exp(-x^2), list(x, -Inf, Inf))) #> \int\limits_{- \infty}^{\infty} e^{- x^{2}}\, dx  ccode(sqrt(x) + Rational(1, 3)) #> sqrt(x) + 1.0/3.0  pprint((x + 1)/(y - 2) + sqrt(x^2 + 1), use_unicode = FALSE) #>            ________ #> x + 1     /  2 #> ----- + \/  x  + 1 #> y - 2

title: Trigonometric simplification — trigsimp_groebner

"fu" runs fu(), "groebner" reduces ideal trigonometric identities trigsimp_groebner(), "combined" runs Groebner method tangent hints futrig(), "old" (old = TRUE) runs pattern based algorithm earlier SymPy versions. inverse = TRUE also simplifies inverse trigonometric functions inverses. exptrigsimp() rewrites exponentials trigonometric hyperbolic functions shorter. futrig() "matching" method .
